Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in New Hope for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Santa's North Pole Express Train, Photos with Santa at Giggleberry Fair and the Gingerbread Competition and Display) through January 9, 2027 (the gingerbread display), with the Holiday Hustle (December 3), Holly Jolly Weekend (December 5 and 6), gingerbread decorating at Sweet Occasions (December 11 to 13), Brunch with Santa at the Cock 'n Bull (December 19 and 20) and Kids Holiday Cookie Night (December 21) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
